statement: SDL PS4 requests feature 0x02 calibration and, on Bluetooth, 0x05 calibration; failed/short or zero calibration falls back to identity bias/scale then converts raw IMU values into SDL sensor units instead of aborting joystick open.

applicability.revision: research revisions: Linux 4056b3c, historical Linux v6.1 830b3c6, SDL 535d80b, OpenPuck 29f4d1e, community 290e4a2; retail revision unknown
applicability.scope: SDL_hidapi_ps4.c 462–647. Source only; do not confuse with kernel normalization.
